name: st.passfa/passfast
title: PassFast
description: Remote HTTPS MCP for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. Paste a sk_live_ secret key once — generate, update, void, and share passes from any MCP client.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer sk_live_… secret API key from the PassFast dashboard (pk_live_ is rejected).

headers.name: X-App-Id
headers.description: Optional app UUID. Required for multi-app orgs; optional for single-app orgs.
